paraphrase: It is impossible that one accomplished in view should treat any formation as permanent, pleasant or self, kill his mother, father or an arahant, shed a Tathāgata's blood or split the Saṅgha, or acknowledge another teacher; impossible that two Buddhas arise in one world-system at once; impossible that a woman should be an arahant fully awakened Buddha, a wheel-turning monarch, Sakka, Māra or Brahmā; impossible that bad conduct should ripen as pleasant.
notes: Sutta id and segment range checked in the local bilara-data copy (Mahāsaṅgīti root text, read alongside Sujato's CC0 English); paraphrase by U36 (skeleton phase, fidelity not yet checked). Recorded faithfully: the text lists a woman's being a sammāsambuddha among the impossibles; it does not deny women arahantship (see Cullavagga 10.1).
